title: 광업ㆍ제조업조사 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:10:0:00010:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 10 (Survey Personnel)
(1) A survey conducting agency shall employ survey personnel who will directly perform survey affairs no later than 30 days before conducting the Mining and Manufacturing Survey.
(2) Where survey personnel employed under paragraph (1) are unable to perform their duties, the survey conducting agency shall immediately employ replacements to perform such duties.
(3) The head of a survey conducting agency shall provide survey personnel, within budgetary limits and in accordance with standards determined by the Administrator of the National Data Agency, with safety equipment necessary for safe performance of survey affairs. <Newly Inserted on November 9, 2021; October 1, 2025>
